onReport(bytes,bytes).details: report = abi.encode(uint256[] postIds, uint64[] impressions, bool[] valid)      valid = author matches AND post contains the disclosure AND post still exists.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: ERC-165, required by the CRE KeystoneForwarder (IReceiver interfaceId = onReport selector).

activePosts(uint256,uint256).notice: One-call read for the CRE workflow (CRE allows only 15 EVM reads per run).         Returns up to `limit` non-rejected posts starting at `offset` in registration order.

close().notice: After endTime: refund everything not held for live posts to the admin's shielded key.

drip(uint256).notice: Pay a stream everything accrued since the last drip (anyone can call, e.g. a cron).

registerPost(uint256,uint64).notice: Anyone (usually the KOL, through the app) registers a post. CRE later checks that         the post's author is `xUserId` and that it carries the ad disclosure.

releaseHoldback(uint256).notice: Release a post's holdback once it has stayed up for `minLifetime` (anyone can call).
